player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} ({role}) wɔ {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies agorɔ mu.
- Ɛkaa round biara, kyerɛ [heads] anaa [tails] (anaa [h], [t]).
- Sɛ wo pɛpɛɛ no ne wo tamfo no di nsɛ, Player 0 na ɔdii nkunim wɔ round no mu; anyɛ yiye a, Player 1 na ɔdii nkunim.
Kyerɛ wo pɛpɛɛ no wɔ '[heads]' anaa '[tails]' mu.

message.round_match: Odwumfo 0 yii {choice0}; Odwumfo 1 yii {choice1}. Akyɛdeɛ -> Odwumfo 0 di nkunim
message.round_mismatch: Odwumfo 0 yii {choice0}; Odwumfo 1 yii {choice1}. Nsonsonoe -> Odwumfo 1 di nkunim.

outcome.p0_wins: Ɔpanyin 0 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.p1_wins: Ɔpanyin 1 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.draw: Ne nyinaa mu no, wɔn ho ankɔ.
